audit_notes: AC-6 is deliberately covered only for its backend-only assertion (freshness accessor invoked, succeeds, nothing in the response) -- no TC asserts a rendered timestamp, per the story's 2026-09-09 Decision log (research C-1) and CLAUDE.md 'do not design it'.

FR-3 (freshness/rollup call-ordering independence) is covered by three TCs deliberately, not one: TC-02 and TC-03 are the two isolated-row cases research called out, TC-04 is the explicit combined fully-fresh case FR-3 itself mandates ('test coverage must include the fully-fresh case ... in addition to the two isolated-row cases'). AC-2 is NOT listed as covered_by TC-04, since TC-04's outcome (500) is the opposite of AC-2's outcome (200 all-zero) -- only the isolated case (TC-02) satisfies AC-2's own assertion.
AC-7 is covered by both TC-03 (isolated: rollup present, system_metadata absent) and TC-04 (combined: both absent) -- both scenarios genuinely trigger and assert the same raise.
FR-1's nullable adoption_percent clause (research Condition 2) is split across TC-01 (populated, non-null) and TC-02 (missing row, null) so both trigger cases from Condition 2 are exercised.

NFR-accessibility has no numeric budget, so per the coverage-minimum rule no dedicated type:security/contract TC was mandated; its color-plus-text-pairing rule is genuinely exercised inside TC-06's legend assertions.

No unit-shaped cases appear here by design (test-case-generation skill, Scope section): format_number()/compute_adoption_percent() already have upstream unit coverage (BED-02), and this story's own new-module unit tests (app/routers/overview.py, frontend AdoptionOverview/SummaryCards/AdoptionIndicator components) belong in docs/features/OVW-01/tasks.json per the story's own Test mapping section.

No TC of type e2e was written: docs/config/project-commands.yaml's test_e2e is empty (no Playwright/Cypress configured). TC-06/TC-07 use type integration (frontend Testing-Library render against a mocked fetch boundary) as the closest runnable substitute for the page-load scenario; TC-08's objective notes this explicitly for the performance budget's frontend/network legs.
